strategic_assessment.headline: The org is stalled at the manual approval bottleneck: 13 funnel fixes and the entire content engine are waiting on Krish.
strategic_assessment.body:
We have a severe misalignment between our automated pipeline and our manual approval gates. Leo has identified 13 critical funnel breaks—including broken CTAs and a pending Stripe webhook—but cannot ship the fixes without Krish's approval. At the same time, Cleo's Content Engine Weekly Sweep has never executed because Tier 1 posts require manual pasting. Nell is ready to launch outreach and Nova has mapped 56 podcasts, but sending cold outbound without a live content trail or a functioning conversion funnel is burning leads for no reason. The system is designed to run fast but is currently throttling at the human layer.

The white space in the market is widening. Zara's signals show enterprise leaders are actively confused about agentic governance and the 'agentic age' implications (McKinsey just published a baseline piece on it). Cloudflare is trying to become the tollbooth for AI web scraping, which perfectly sets up the AdFixus thesis. The hooks are live, but we are completely silent.
strategic_assessment.recommended_focus: Approve Leo's top 3 funnel fixes (especially Stripe/CTAs) so we can process conversions, and unblock Cleo's content publishing so Nell's outreach has a warm landing pad. Do not start outbound until the funnel works.

metrics.interpretation: Feedback Distributor has failed three consecutive times, blinding us to product signals. Needs immediate debugging.

external_signals.signal: McKinsey publishes 'The change agent: Goals, decisions, and implications for CEOs in the agentic age', establishing a mainstream baseline for CEO expectations.
external_signals.relevance: CEOs are turning to major consultancies for agentic AI strategy; Krish can position Mindmaker as the faster, more pragmatic alternative.
external_signals.recommended_action: Cleo drafts a 'What McKinsey missed about the agentic age' post targeting CEOs, framing Mindmaker's strategy sprints as the antidote to slow consulting.

external_signals.signal: Conversations around 'Governing AI Agents at Scale' and 'Security, Compliance and Control' are rising among enterprise leaders.
external_signals.relevance: This perfectly hits the emerging theme of 'enterprise AI governance accountability' — an unanswered question in the post-pilot era.
external_signals.recommended_action: Cleo to draft an op-ed: 'Who gets fired when your AI agent makes a mistake? The missing governance layer in 2026'.

external_signals.signal: Call for Contributions (CfC) open for Legal Governance of AI conference.
external_signals.relevance: Provides an immediate, open submission path to speak directly to governance and accountability decision-makers.
external_signals.recommended_action: Nova to submit a proposal abstract on 'Enterprise AI Accountability: Frameworks for Agentic Failure'.

external_signals.signal: Cloudflare announces pay-per-crawl service to block AI crawlers by default, attempting to become the tollbooth for AI scraping.
external_signals.relevance: Validates the AdFixus thesis that publisher infrastructure ownership is critical when AI agents browse instead of humans.
external_signals.recommended_action: Cleo queues an AdFixus piece: 'Why publishers shouldn't let Cloudflare own their AI crawler revenue stream'.

external_signals.signal: Digiday reports 'No playbook, just pressure: Publishers eye the rise of agentic browsers', highlighting industry paralysis.
external_signals.relevance: Publishers are actively looking for the playbook on agentic traffic monetisation, which is exactly what AdFixus provides.
external_signals.recommended_action: Nell uses this Digiday article as a 'hook' in outbound emails to publisher execs this week: 'Read the Digiday piece — we have the playbook they said was missing'.
